ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: Lekaa uses your contacts only when you tap to pick a number to add someone to your team — contacts never leave your phone
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: The app needs access to your photos to send pictures for the AI assistant to see
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: The app needs the camera to take photos (e.g. payment slips, receipts, products) for the AI assistant to see
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Lekaa to access your microphone
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Lekaa uses your phone's calendar to show your appointments alongside shop work and to save personal appointments you create — data never leaves your phone
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Lekaa uses your phone's calendar to show your appointments alongside shop work and to save personal appointments you create — data never leaves your phone
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Lekaa does not use your phone's Reminders — data never leaves your phone
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Lekaa does not use your phone's Reminders — data never leaves your phone
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Lekaa to use Face ID
